past.title: RoboCup Junior Australia 2026 Open National Championships
past.excerpt: RoboCup Junior Australia is a project-oriented educational initiative that supports local, regional and international robotic events for young students. Australia has been hosting national competitions for 26 years, attracting students from across Australia to compete against one another. Tens of thousands of students around Australia participate in RoboCup, with thousands more around the world. past.title: WORLD HUMANOID ROBOT GAMES SHL
past.excerpt: The World Humanoid Robot Games is the world's first international, comprehensive science and technology sports event with humanoid robots as the primary competitors. Co-hosted by the People’s Government of Beijing Municipality, China Media Group (CMG), World Robot Cooperation Organization, and RoboCup Asia-Pacific Confederation Board of Trustees, the Games brings together leading forces from around the globe in the fields of robot research, development, and application. past.title: ROBOCUP 2026 INCHEON
past.excerpt: For the first time in its history, RoboCup, the world’s largest and most prestigious robotics and artificial intelligence competition, will be held in South Korea. RoboCup 2026 will take place from June 30 to July 6, 2026, at Songdo Convensia in Incheon, and is expected to bring together more than 3,000 competitors, researchers, students, and professionals from dozens of countries, as well as 15,000 visitors interested in robotics, to South Korea.
